test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

This TV channel has a larger viewership __from another channel__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'than any other channel'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'than any other channel' **should be used instead of **'from another channel'.**
 
• We always use ‘**than**’ when we do a comparison between two things, people, etc.
 
• Similarly in the given sentence, the viewership of a TV channel is being compared with all the other channels.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *This TV channel has a larger viewership **than any other channel.***
